notes: OGLE-IV (Warsaw 1.3 m, Las Campanas) V and I. Published curve = Asahi filter transmission (mean of 9 spots, OGLE-IV-{V,I}-filter-transmission.dat) x e2v CCD44-82 specification QE (OGLE-IV-QE-curve-from-specification.dat, set to 0 outside 3032-10787 A); photon-counting CCDs. No telescope optics or atmosphere included. Components: filter (per band) and qe (shared). The measured QE min/max envelope (OGLE-IV-QE-measured-min-max-curves.dat, columns verified as min<=max) is not used; the pivot with its midpoint is in provenance. Caveat: the filter scans have a low-signal noise floor below ~3500 A (quantised spot values, up to 0.1 in V and 0.29 in I) kept as published apart from negatives set to 0; after the QE (0 below 3032 A) it carries ~0.2 % of the photon-weighted response and shifts the pivot by ~0.2-0.5 % vs zeroing below 3500 A. No published pivot.
